title: AgentStepStartedPayload
description: agent.step.started v1 (design 2026-11-07 §2). A step began: the mode started working on it. Envelope: source the mode that runs it (a first-party service), subject the person it is for, visibility internal, actor the person or the mode. The payload is common.agent-step@1: titles, outcomes and links only, never a prompt or a diff.
